minor.issue: No server-side per-user cap on number of concurrent upload_id chunk directories or on cumulative chunk bytes on disk. A malicious authenticated user could DoS disk by opening many upload_ids and uploading up to 500*chunk_size bytes each without ever finalizing. Consider janitor task to purge chunk dirs older than N hours + per-user cap. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_UPLOAD_ID_RE (^[a-f0-9]{16,64}$) is a strong path-traversal guard, and CHUNKS_DIR path is composed by joining user_id (server-controlled from auth) + upload_id (regex-validated). Safe.
server.py:upload_chunk validates chunk_index bounds (0<=i<total, total<=500). Good.

server.py:finalize_chunked_upload asserts len(parts) == total_chunks by counting *.part files in the dir — this could pass even if the user replayed the same chunk_index (previous PUT overwrites the file, so count stays right). Not a security issue since data integrity for a fake video only affects the uploading user's own analysis, but worth noting.
api.ts:makeUploadId() concatenates Date.now().toString(16) + two Math.random().toString(16).slice(2) truncated to 32 chars — all outputs are 0-9a-f, matches the server regex. Good.

api.ts:postFormWithRetry retries up to 3x with 1s/2s/3s backoff on network err or 5xx/429 — matches the requested behavior. Client-side 4xx short-circuits, preventing wasted retries on auth/quota failures.
api.ts chunk size 3MB (CHUNK_SIZE = 3*1024*1024) — safely under typical Cloudflare 100MB and any 6-10MB proxy body limits.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: single POST /api/analyses of large videos hit Cloudflare edge before backend, returning 520 'Web server returned unknown error' because body/timeout exceeded proxy limits. Fix (verified this iteration): frontend now slices >3MB videos into 3MB chunks, POSTs each chunk to /api/uploads/chunk (small enough to always sail past the proxy) with retry on 5xx/network, then calls /api/analyses/finalize to reassemble server-side and kick off the normal ffmpeg+AI pipeline. Backend endpoints enforce upload_id regex, chunk-index bounds, quota, and cleanup. Reproduction & verification: uploaded an 8MB fake mp4 through the preview URL upload tab; UPLOADING... % overlay was shown and app navigated to /analysis/<id> with no 520 error.
